nodes.label: EditorViewModelTest.kt
EditorViewModelTest
OptIn
ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
Rule
.recipe()
.`a new empty recipe is never inserted`()
Test
.`typing a title inserts once after debounce then updates the same id`()
.`yield text persists via QuantityParser`()
.`opening an existing recipe loads it and onCleared flushes immediately`()
.`paste into blank rows replaces silently`()
.`paste into non-blank rows confirms then replaces or appends`()
.`append truncates at the cap and reports dropped rows`()
.`a session-created recipe emptied is deleted on flush but a pre-existing one is not`()
.`delete removes the recipe and navigates up`()
.`flush after delete does not resurrect the recipe or crash`()
.`a recipe deleted elsewhere is not resurrected by the debounced save`()
.`prepareToScale flushes and returns the id or null when empty`()
.`deleteRecipe saves latest edits first so undo restores them`()
.`moveRow moves a row to the target position and ignores unknown keys`()
.`inferFromName splits quantity and unit out of the name`()
.`inferFromName handles fractions and bare quantities`()
.`inferFromName is a no-op without a quantity or with an existing qty`()
.`initialTitle prefills the title and autofocuses the first row without saving`()
